name: Foreman
text: Foreman: When doing the Establish Supply Line action, spend 1 fewer Supply cube.

mechanics.effect: Establish Supply Line costs 1 fewer Supply cube.
restrictions: Applies when doing the Establish Supply Line action
mechanics.notes: The production cost is not printed on the sticker. The package manifest lists it as 2 Production Units. The action name on the sticker is Establish Supply Line.
